addBuyOrder(uint32,uint96,bool).details: Adds a buy order to the order book.

params._postOnly: Whether the order is post-only. The transaction reverts if the order is matched while placing.

addFlipBuyOrder(uint32,uint32,uint96,boo.details: Adds a flip buy order to the order book. This function will just return if it matches against the book.

params._flippedPrice: Price of the sell order to which this order will flip on a fill
params._provisionOrRevert: The transaction reverts if this is set to true and the flip order matches on placement.

addFlipSellOrder(uint32,uint32,uint96,bo.details: Adds a flip sell order to the order book. This function will just return if it matches against the book.

params._flippedPrice: Price of the buy order to which this order will flip on a fill
params._provisionOrRevert: The transaction reverts if this is set to true and the flip order matches on placement.

addPairedLiquidity(uint32,uint32,uint96,.details: Adds a paired liquidity order to the order book. This function will revert if the order matches against the book.

addSellOrder(uint32,uint96,bool).details: Adds a sell order to the order book.

params._postOnly: Whether the order is post-only. The transaction reverts if the order is matched while placing.

batchAddPairedLiquidity(uint32[],uint32[.details: Batch adds paired liquidity to the order book.

params.askPrices: Array of prices for the ask orders.
params.askSizes: Array of sizes for the ask orders.
params.bidPrices: Array of prices for the bid orders.
params.bidSizes: Array of sizes for the bid orders.

batchCancelFlipOrders(uint40[]).details: Cancels multiple flip orders in a batch. For a flip order pair, you only need to input ID of one of the orders.

params._orderIds: Array of order IDs to cancel.

batchCancelOrders(uint40[]).details: Cancels multiple orders in a batch.Reverts if you pass an order ID which is filled or cancelled already.

params._orderIds: Array of order IDs to cancel.

batchCancelOrdersNoRevert(uint40[]).details: Cancels multiple orders in a batch.Does not revert if you pass an order ID which is filled or cancelled already.

params._orderIds: Array of order IDs to cancel.

batchProvisionLiquidity(uint32[],uint32[.details: Batch adds flip orders to the order book.

params._provisionOrRevert: If set to true, if a flip order matches against the book, the transaction reverts.
params.flipPrices: Array of prices for the flip orders.
params.isBuy: Array of booleans indicating if the i'th order is a buy order
params.prices: Array of prices for the flip orders.
params.sizes: Array of sizes for the flip orders.

batchUpdate(uint32[],uint96[],uint32[],u.details: Batch updates orders by placing multiple buy and sell orders and canceling orders.

params.buyPrices: Array of prices for the buy orders.
params.buySizes: Array of sizes for the buy orders.
params.orderIdsToCancel: Array of order IDs to cancel.
params.postOnly: Boolean indicating if the orders should be post-only.
params.sellPrices: Array of prices for the sell orders.
params.sellSizes: Array of sizes for the sell orders.

bestBidAsk().details: Returns the best bid and the best ask of the market.

collectFees().details: Calls the creditFee function in MarginAccount

getL2Book().details: This is useful if you want the complete order book, but may fail if the number of price points is a lot

returns._0: data Encoded bytes containing the block number, prices, and sizes of the buy and sell orders.

getL2Book(uint32,uint32).details: Encodes the block number, buy orders, and sell orders. Pass the number of bid and ask price points you need

returns.data: Encoded bytes containing the block number, prices, and sizes of the buy and sell orders.
